title: Register Transfer Loop
statement: Let $A$ be a register program with $m$ registers and $d$ oracle deciders, let $x$ be an input, and let $B$ be a natural-number bound. Suppose distinct registers $r,t$ and states $l,l_x,l_1,l_2$ satisfy: at $l$ the program branches to $l_x$ when register $r$ is zero and to $l_1$ otherwise; at $l_1$ it decrements $r$ and proceeds to $l_2$; and at $l_2$ it increments $t$ and returns to $l$. For every $k$ and register assignment $v$ with $v(r)=k$, with every register value at most $B$, and with $v(t)+v(r)\le B$, the configuration at $l$ reaches the configuration at $l_x$ with $r$ set to zero and $t$ set to its original value $v(t)+v(r)$, all other registers unchanged, and no answer recorded; every configuration before the final one satisfies the program's precondition and has all register values at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is an $m$-register program with $d$ deciders; oracle and input $x$ are fixed
The instructions at $l,l_1,l_2$ are respectively the stated zero-test, decrement, and increment
Every register value under $v$ is at most $B$
